source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to mass spectrometry (PDF 195).

blocks.text: Mass spectrometry na-maloom compounds pehchanne ka tajziyati tareeqa hai. Chhote sample ke molecules ya atoms par zyada tawanai wale electrons ki bauchhaar ki jati hai, jo molecule ya atom se aik electron nikal sakti hai. Banne wala musbat ion pakra aur m/e (ion ka mass aur charge ka tanasub) ke muqable ions ke feesad ki shakal mein darj kiya jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Mass spectrum ka ufqi axis kya dikhata hai?
blocks.explanation: m/e, har ion ka mass aur charge ka tanasub (aik charge wale ion ke liye us ka mass).

items: Electrons ki bauchhaar musbat ions banati; spectrum m/e ke muqable miqdar dikhata.
